1.name: Brawler
1.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff6352|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff6352|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff7071|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3137|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff3205|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff11073|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Killer's Blade
4.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff4008|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff7514|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

5.name: Echoing Vigor
5.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff16362|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

6.name: The Tide King's Gaze
6.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff3748|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.

6.name: Fated Fortune
6.description: Warp fate when you generate or consume Crux, increasing your Critical Damage and Critical Healing by |cffffff12|r% for |cffffff7|r seconds.

7.name: Harnessed Quintessence
7.description:
You master the warp and weft of your very soul. 

When you restore Magicka or Stamina, your Weapon and Spell Damage increase by |cffffff284|r for |cffffff10|r seconds.

8.name: Psychic Lesion

While transformed, your damaging Light Attacks restore |cffffff2248|r Health and your fully-charged Heavy Attacks restore |cffffff5620|r Health. This ability scales off your Max Health.

1.name: Blur

While active, taking direct damage reduces the cost of your next Roll Dodge by |cffffff10|r%, up to a maximum of |cffffff100|r%. This effect can stack up to once every half second.

2.name: Shadow Cloak
2.description:
Cloak yourself in shadow to become invisible. When moving your Magicka Recovery is disabled and when not moving Shadow Cloak is half cost.

When Shadow Cloak begins or ends, you gain Born From Shadow for |cffffff15|r seconds, increasing your damage done to monsters by |cffffff15|r%.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

3.name: Path of Darkness
3.description: Create a corridor of shadows for |cffffff10|r seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%. Effect persists for |cffffff4|r seconds after leaving the path.

4.name: Aspect of Terror
4.description: Embody a dark spirit to terrify nearby enemies, causing them to cower in fear for |cffffff2|r seconds and be afflicted with Major Cowardice for |cffffff10|r seconds, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff430|r.

5.name: Summon Shade
5.description:
Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for |cffffff20|r seconds. 

The shade slashes at an enemy, dealing |cffffff829|r Magic Damage once every |cffffff2|r seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for |cffffff4|r seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Consuming Darkness
6.description:
Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by |cffffff70|r% and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by |cffffff70|r%, and healing them for |cffffff16285|r Health over |cffffff4|r seconds.

5.trait: Increases Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff1428|r.

Shroud yourself in protective shadow to heal for |cffffff4198|r Health every |cffffff1|r second, over |cffffff3|r seconds, increasing by an additional |cffffff150|r% while Bracing. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

3.name: Path of Darkness
3.description: Create a corridor of shadows for |cffffff12|r seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%. Effect persists for |cffffff4|r seconds after leaving the path.

4.name: Aspect of Terror
4.description: Embody a dark spirit to terrify nearby enemies, causing them to cower in fear for |cffffff4|r seconds and be afflicted with Major Cowardice for |cffffff12|r seconds, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff430|r.

5.name: Summon Shade
5.description:
Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for |cffffff22|r seconds. 

The shade slashes at an enemy, dealing |cffffff788|r Magic Damage once every |cffffff2|r seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for |cffffff4|r seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Consuming Darkness
6.description:
Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by |cffffff70|r% and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by |cffffff70|r%, and healing them for |cffffff15470|r Health over |cffffff4|r seconds.

2.name: Refreshing Shadows
2.description: Increases your Health, Stamina, and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff15|r%.

3.name: Shadow Barrier
3.description:
Casting a Shadow ability grants you Major Resolve for |cffffff12|r seconds, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r. This duration is increased by |cffffff2|r seconds for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current duration: |cffffff26|r seconds

4.name: Dark Vigor
4.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff5|r% for each Shadow ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff30|r%.

5.name: Dark Veil
5.description:
Increases the duration of your Shadow abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

Does not apply to Shadow Cloak or its morphs.

6.name: Expert Summoner
6.description:
Increases your Magicka and Stamina by |cffffff5|r%.

Increases your Max Health by |cffffff5|r% if you have a permanent summoned combat pet active.

4.description: (1 item) Reduces your Block Mitigation to |cffffff0|r.

2.description:
(2 items) Casting an ability that costs Health spawns a blood ball for |cffffff10|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds. 

You or an ally near the blood ball can activate the Sanguine Burst synergy, dealing |cffffff14161|r Disease Damage to nearby enemies and applying Major Maim for |cffffff8|r seconds, decreasing their damage done by |cffffff10|r%. Enemies can only receive Major Maim from Sanguine Burst once every |cffffff20|r seconds. The damage scales off the synergy activator's Max Health.

5.description: (5 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Magicka

6.description: (6 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Stamina

7.description: (7 items) Adds 1662 Maximum Health

8.description: (8 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Magicka

9.description: (9 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Stamina

5.trait: Increases Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff1580|r.

While active, taking direct damage reduces the cost of your next Roll Dodge by |cffffff10|r%, up to a maximum of |cffffff100|r%. This effect can stack up to once every half second.

2.name: Dark Cloak
2.description:
Shroud yourself in protective shadow to heal for |cffffff4396|r Health every |cffffff1|r second, over |cffffff3|r seconds, increasing by an additional |cffffff150|r% while Bracing. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

3.name: Path of Darkness
3.description: Create a corridor of shadows for |cffffff12|r seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%. Effect persists for |cffffff4|r seconds after leaving the path.

4.name: Aspect of Terror
4.description: Embody a dark spirit to terrify nearby enemies, causing them to cower in fear for |cffffff4|r seconds and be afflicted with Major Cowardice for |cffffff12|r seconds, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff430|r.

5.name: Summon Shade
5.description:
Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for |cffffff22|r seconds. 

The shade slashes at an enemy, dealing |cffffff749|r Magic Damage once every |cffffff2|r seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for |cffffff4|r seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Consuming Darkness
6.description:
Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by |cffffff70|r% and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by |cffffff70|r%, and healing them for |cffffff14730|r Health over |cffffff4|r seconds.

2.name: Refreshing Shadows
2.description: Increases your Health, Stamina, and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff15|r%.

3.name: Shadow Barrier
3.description:
Casting a Shadow ability grants you Major Resolve for |cffffff12|r seconds, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r. This duration is increased by |cffffff2|r seconds for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current duration: |cffffff26|r seconds

4.name: Dark Vigor
4.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff5|r% for each Shadow ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff30|r%.

5.name: Dark Veil
5.description:
Increases the duration of your Shadow abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

Does not apply to Shadow Cloak or its morphs.

6.name: Accelerated Growth
6.description: When you heal yourself or an ally under |cffffff40|r% Health with a Green Balance ability you gain Major Mending, increasing your healing done by |cffffff16|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

7.name: Nature's Gift
7.description: When you overheal yourself or an ally with a Green Balance ability, you gain |cffffff250|r Magicka and |cffffff250|r Stamina, up to once every |cffffff1|r second.

8.name: Emerald Moss
8.description:
Increases your healing done with Green Balance abilities by |cffffff5|r% for each Green Balance ability slotted.

Current Bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

9.name: Maturation
9.description: When you activate a heal on yourself or an ally you grant the target Minor Toughness, increasing their Max Health by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff20|r seconds.

4.description: (1 item) Reduces your Block Mitigation to |cffffff0|r.

2.description:
(2 items) Casting an ability that costs Health spawns a blood ball for |cffffff10|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds. 

You or an ally near the blood ball can activate the Sanguine Burst synergy, dealing |cffffff14830|r Disease Damage to nearby enemies and applying Major Maim for |cffffff8|r seconds, decreasing their damage done by |cffffff10|r%. Enemies can only receive Major Maim from Sanguine Burst once every |cffffff20|r seconds. The damage scales off the synergy activator's Max Health.

5.description: (5 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Magicka

6.description: (6 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Stamina

7.description: (7 items) Adds 1662 Maximum Health

8.description: (8 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Magicka

9.description: (9 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Stamina

5.trait: Increases Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff1580|r.

3.name: Vampire Stage 1
3.effect:
You are slightly corrupted from the influence of Vampirism.

Health Recovery: -10%
Flame Damage Taken: +5%
Regular Ability Costs: +3%
Vampire Ability Costs: -6%

4.name: Increase Max Health
4.description: Increase Max Health by |cffffff0|r for |cffffff35|r minutes.

Heals for |cffffff15|r% more on allies that are within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

2.name: Ravenous Goliath
2.description:

Shroud yourself in protective shadow to heal for |cffffff6975|r Health every |cffffff1|r second, over |cffffff3|r seconds, increasing by an additional |cffffff150|r% while Bracing. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

3.name: Path of Darkness
3.description: Create a corridor of shadows for |cffffff12|r seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%. Effect persists for |cffffff4|r seconds after leaving the path.

4.name: Aspect of Terror
4.description: Embody a dark spirit to terrify nearby enemies, causing them to cower in fear for |cffffff4|r seconds and be afflicted with Major Cowardice for |cffffff12|r seconds, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff430|r.

5.name: Summon Shade
5.description:
Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for |cffffff22|r seconds. 

The shade slashes at an enemy, dealing |cffffff1155|r Magic Damage once every |cffffff2|r seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for |cffffff4|r seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Consuming Darkness
6.description:
Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by |cffffff70|r% and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by |cffffff70|r%, and healing them for |cffffff21580|r Health over |cffffff4|r seconds.

2.name: Refreshing Shadows
2.description: Increases your Health, Stamina, and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff15|r%.

3.name: Shadow Barrier
3.description:
Casting a Shadow ability grants you Major Resolve for |cffffff12|r seconds, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r. This duration is increased by |cffffff2|r seconds for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current duration: |cffffff26|r seconds

4.name: Dark Vigor
4.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff5|r% for each Shadow ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff30|r%.

5.name: Dark Veil
5.description:
Increases the duration of your Shadow abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

Does not apply to Shadow Cloak or its morphs.

6.name: Accelerated Growth
6.description: When you heal yourself or an ally under |cffffff40|r% Health with a Green Balance ability you gain Major Mending, increasing your healing done by |cffffff16|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

7.name: Nature's Gift
7.description: When you overheal yourself or an ally with a Green Balance ability, you gain |cffffff250|r Magicka and |cffffff250|r Stamina, up to once every |cffffff1|r second.

8.name: Emerald Moss
8.description:
Increases your healing done with Green Balance abilities by |cffffff5|r% for each Green Balance ability slotted.

9.name: Maturation
9.description: When you activate a heal on yourself or an ally you grant the target Minor Toughness, increasing their Max Health by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff20|r seconds.

Surround yourself in a phantasmic aura to gain Major Evasion, reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

While active, taking direct damage reduces the cost of your next Roll Dodge by |cffffff10|r%, up to a maximum of |cffffff100|r%. This effect can stack up to once every half second.

2.name: Dark Cloak
2.description:
Shroud yourself in protective shadow to heal for |cffffff4572|r Health every |cffffff1|r second, over |cffffff3|r seconds, increasing by an additional |cffffff150|r% while Bracing. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

3.name: Path of Darkness
3.description: Create a corridor of shadows for |cffffff12|r seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%. Effect persists for |cffffff4|r seconds after leaving the path.

4.name: Aspect of Terror
4.description: Embody a dark spirit to terrify nearby enemies, causing them to cower in fear for |cffffff4|r seconds and be afflicted with Major Cowardice for |cffffff12|r seconds, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff430|r.

5.name: Summon Shade
5.description:
Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for |cffffff22|r seconds. 

The shade slashes at an enemy, dealing |cffffff749|r Magic Damage once every |cffffff2|r seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for |cffffff4|r seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Consuming Darkness
6.description:
Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by |cffffff70|r% and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by |cffffff70|r%, and healing them for |cffffff14730|r Health over |cffffff4|r seconds.

2.name: Refreshing Shadows
2.description: Increases your Health, Stamina, and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff15|r%.

3.name: Shadow Barrier
3.description:
Casting a Shadow ability grants you Major Resolve for |cffffff12|r seconds, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r. This duration is increased by |cffffff2|r seconds for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current duration: |cffffff26|r seconds

4.name: Dark Vigor
4.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff5|r% for each Shadow ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff30|r%.

5.name: Dark Veil
5.description:
Increases the duration of your Shadow abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

Does not apply to Shadow Cloak or its morphs.

6.name: Accelerated Growth
6.description: When you heal yourself or an ally under |cffffff40|r% Health with a Green Balance ability you gain Major Mending, increasing your healing done by |cffffff16|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

7.name: Nature's Gift
7.description: When you overheal yourself or an ally with a Green Balance ability, you gain |cffffff250|r Magicka and |cffffff250|r Stamina, up to once every |cffffff1|r second.

8.name: Emerald Moss
8.description:
Increases your healing done with Green Balance abilities by |cffffff5|r% for each Green Balance ability slotted.

Current Bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

9.name: Maturation
9.description: When you activate a heal on yourself or an ally you grant the target Minor Toughness, increasing their Max Health by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff20|r seconds.

2.description: (2 items) When you take damage, you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to tether to your enemy for |cffffff6|r seconds, as long as you remain within 8 meters of them. While tethered, you deal |cffffff1668|r Magic Damage every second to the enemy, heal for the damage caused, and gain Major Vitality, increasing your healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds and scales off your Max Health.

(2 items) Casting an ability that costs Health spawns a blood ball for |cffffff10|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds. 

You or an ally near the blood ball can activate the Sanguine Burst synergy, dealing |cffffff15421|r Disease Damage to nearby enemies and applying Major Maim for |cffffff8|r seconds, decreasing their damage done by |cffffff10|r%. Enemies can only receive Major Maim from Sanguine Burst once every |cffffff20|r seconds. The damage scales off the synergy activator's Max Health.

5.description: (5 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Magicka

6.description: (6 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Stamina

7.description: (7 items) Adds 1662 Maximum Health

8.description: (8 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Magicka

9.description: (9 items) Adds 1510 Maximum Stamina

5.trait: Increases Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff1580|r.

1.description: (1 item) Gain a persistent stack of Escalating Fete every |cffffff2|r seconds you are in combat, up to 30 stacks max. Each stack of Escalating Fete increases your Maximum Stamina, Health, and Magicka by |cffffff88|r. You lose a stack of Escalating Fete every |cffffff4|r seconds you are out of combat.

Become a horrific Ravenous Goliath, increasing your Max Health by |cffffff30000|r for |cffffff20|r seconds and immediately restoring |cffffff30000|r Health. You cannot conceal your presence while active.

While transformed, your damaging Light Attacks restore |cffffff2928|r Health and fully-charged Heavy Attacks restore |cffffff7321|r Health. You deal |cffffff7940|r Magic Damage to nearby enemies every second and heal for that amount. These abilities scale off your Max Health.

19.name: Minor Heroism
19.effect: While in combat, grants you |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

2.description: (2 items) When you take damage, you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to tether to your enemy for |cffffff6|r seconds, as long as you remain within 8 meters of them. While tethered, you deal |cffffff2994|r Magic Damage every second to the enemy, heal for the damage caused, and gain Major Vitality, increasing your healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds and scales off your Max Health.

(2 items) Casting an ability that costs Health spawns a blood ball for |cffffff10|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds. 

You or an ally near the blood ball can activate the Sanguine Burst synergy, dealing |cffffff27671|r Disease Damage to nearby enemies and applying Major Maim for |cffffff8|r seconds, decreasing their damage done by |cffffff10|r%. Enemies can only receive Major Maim from Sanguine Burst once every |cffffff20|r seconds. The damage scales off the synergy activator's Max Health.

1.name: Blur
1.description:
Surround yourself in a phantasmic aura to gain Major Evasion, reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

While active, taking direct damage reduces the cost of your next Roll Dodge by |cffffff10|r%, up to a maximum of |cffffff100|r%. This effect can stack up to once every half second.

2.name: Dark Cloak
2.description:
Shroud yourself in protective shadow to heal for |cffffff7812|r Health every |cffffff1|r second, over |cffffff3|r seconds, increasing by an additional |cffffff150|r% while Bracing. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

3.name: Path of Darkness
3.description: Create a corridor of shadows for |cffffff12|r seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%. Effect persists for |cffffff4|r seconds after leaving the path.

4.name: Aspect of Terror
4.description: Embody a dark spirit to terrify nearby enemies, causing them to cower in fear for |cffffff4|r seconds and be afflicted with Major Cowardice for |cffffff12|r seconds, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff430|r.

5.name: Summon Shade
5.description:
Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for |cffffff22|r seconds. 

The shade slashes at an enemy, dealing |cffffff1278|r Magic Damage once every |cffffff2|r seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for |cffffff4|r seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Consuming Darkness
6.description:
Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by |cffffff70|r% and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by |cffffff70|r%, and healing them for |cffffff23880|r Health over |cffffff4|r seconds.

Surround yourself in a phantasmic aura to gain Major Evasion, reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

While active, taking direct damage reduces the cost of your next Roll Dodge by |cffffff10|r%, up to a maximum of |cffffff100|r%. This effect can stack up to once every half second.

2.name: Dark Cloak
2.description:
Shroud yourself in protective shadow to heal for |cffffff4966|r Health every |cffffff1|r second, over |cffffff3|r seconds, increasing by an additional |cffffff150|r% while Bracing. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

3.name: Path of Darkness
3.description: Create a corridor of shadows for |cffffff12|r seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%. Effect persists for |cffffff4|r seconds after leaving the path.

4.name: Aspect of Terror
4.description: Embody a dark spirit to terrify nearby enemies, causing them to cower in fear for |cffffff4|r seconds and be afflicted with Major Cowardice for |cffffff12|r seconds, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff430|r.

5.name: Summon Shade
5.description:
Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for |cffffff22|r seconds. 

The shade slashes at an enemy, dealing |cffffff839|r Magic Damage once every |cffffff2|r seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for |cffffff4|r seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Consuming Darkness
6.description:
Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by |cffffff70|r% and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by |cffffff70|r%, and healing them for |cffffff16485|r Health over |cffffff4|r seconds.

1.name: Death Gleaning
1.description: Whenever an enemy you are in combat with dies within |cffffff28|r meters of you, restore |cffffff666|r Magicka and Stamina.

2.name: Disdain Harm
2.description: Reduce the damage you take from damage over time abilities by |cffffff15|r% while you have a Bone Tyrant ability active.

3.name: Health Avarice
3.description:
Increase your Healing Received by |cffffff3|r% for each Bone Tyrant ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

5.name: Refreshing Shadows
5.description: Increases your Health, Stamina, and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff15|r%.

6.name: Shadow Barrier
6.description:
Casting a Shadow ability grants you Major Resolve for |cffffff12|r seconds, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r. This duration is increased by |cffffff2|r seconds for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current duration: |cffffff26|r seconds

7.name: Dark Vigor
7.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff5|r% for each Shadow ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff30|r%.

8.name: Dark Veil
8.description:
Increases the duration of your Shadow abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

Does not apply to Shadow Cloak or its morphs.

9.name: Accelerated Growth
9.description: When you heal yourself or an ally under |cffffff40|r% Health with a Green Balance ability you gain Major Mending, increasing your healing done by |cffffff16|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

10.name: Nature's Gift
10.description: When you overheal yourself or an ally with a Green Balance ability, you gain |cffffff250|r Magicka and |cffffff250|r Stamina, up to once every |cffffff1|r second.

11.name: Emerald Moss
11.description:
Increases your healing done with Green Balance abilities by |cffffff5|r% for each Green Balance ability slotted.

Current Bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

12.name: Maturation
12.description: When you activate a heal on yourself or an ally you grant the target Minor Toughness, increasing their Max Health by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff20|r seconds.

4.name: Increase Max Health
4.description: Increase Max Health by |cffffff0|r for |cffffff35|r minutes.

2.description: (2 items) When you take damage, you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to tether to your enemy for |cffffff6|r seconds, as long as you remain within 8 meters of them. While tethered, you deal |cffffff1813|r Magic Damage every second to the enemy, heal for the damage caused, and gain Major Vitality, increasing your healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds and scales off your Max Health.

(2 items) Casting an ability that costs Health spawns a blood ball for |cffffff10|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds. 

You or an ally near the blood ball can activate the Sanguine Burst synergy, dealing |cffffff16753|r Disease Damage to nearby enemies and applying Major Maim for |cffffff8|r seconds, decreasing their damage done by |cffffff10|r%. Enemies can only receive Major Maim from Sanguine Burst once every |cffffff20|r seconds. The damage scales off the synergy activator's Max Health.

5.description: (5 items) Adds 1565 Maximum Magicka

6.description: (6 items) Adds 1565 Maximum Stamina

7.description: (7 items) Adds 1722 Maximum Health

8.description: (8 items) Adds 1565 Maximum Magicka

9.description: (9 items) Adds 1565 Maximum Stamina

5.trait: Increases Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff1638|r.

While active, taking direct damage reduces the cost of your next Roll Dodge by |cffffff10|r%, up to a maximum of |cffffff100|r%. This effect can stack up to once every half second.

2.name: Dark Cloak
2.description:
Shroud yourself in protective shadow to heal for |cffffff4797|r Health every |cffffff1|r second, over |cffffff3|r seconds, increasing by an additional |cffffff150|r% while Bracing. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

3.name: Path of Darkness
3.description: Create a corridor of shadows for |cffffff12|r seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%. Effect persists for |cffffff4|r seconds after leaving the path.

4.name: Aspect of Terror
4.description: Embody a dark spirit to terrify nearby enemies, causing them to cower in fear for |cffffff4|r seconds and be afflicted with Major Cowardice for |cffffff12|r seconds, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff430|r.

5.name: Summon Shade
5.description:
Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for |cffffff22|r seconds. 

The shade slashes at an enemy, dealing |cffffff794|r Magic Damage once every |cffffff2|r seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for |cffffff4|r seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Consuming Darkness
6.description:
Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by |cffffff70|r% and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by |cffffff70|r%, and healing them for |cffffff15595|r Health over |cffffff4|r seconds.

1.name: Death Gleaning
1.description: Whenever an enemy you are in combat with dies within |cffffff28|r meters of you, restore |cffffff666|r Magicka and Stamina.

2.name: Disdain Harm
2.description: Reduce the damage you take from damage over time abilities by |cffffff15|r% while you have a Bone Tyrant ability active.

3.name: Health Avarice
3.description:
Increase your Healing Received by |cffffff3|r% for each Bone Tyrant ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

5.name: Refreshing Shadows
5.description: Increases your Health, Stamina, and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff15|r%.

6.name: Shadow Barrier
6.description:
Casting a Shadow ability grants you Major Resolve for |cffffff12|r seconds, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r. This duration is increased by |cffffff2|r seconds for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current duration: |cffffff26|r seconds

7.name: Dark Vigor
7.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff5|r% for each Shadow ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff30|r%.

8.name: Dark Veil
8.description:
Increases the duration of your Shadow abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

Does not apply to Shadow Cloak or its morphs.

9.name: Accelerated Growth
9.description: When you heal yourself or an ally under |cffffff40|r% Health with a Green Balance ability you gain Major Mending, increasing your healing done by |cffffff16|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

10.name: Nature's Gift
10.description: When you overheal yourself or an ally with a Green Balance ability, you gain |cffffff250|r Magicka and |cffffff250|r Stamina, up to once every |cffffff1|r second.

11.name: Emerald Moss
11.description:
Increases your healing done with Green Balance abilities by |cffffff5|r% for each Green Balance ability slotted.

Current Bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

12.name: Maturation
12.description: When you activate a heal on yourself or an ally you grant the target Minor Toughness, increasing their Max Health by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff20|r seconds.

3.name: Increase Max Health
3.effect: Increase Max Health by |cffffff6607|r.
3.description: Increase Max Health by |cffffff0|r for |cffffff35|r minutes.

2.description: (2 items) When you take damage, you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to tether to your enemy for |cffffff6|r seconds, as long as you remain within 8 meters of them. While tethered, you deal |cffffff1751|r Magic Damage every second to the enemy, heal for the damage caused, and gain Major Vitality, increasing your healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%. This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds and scales off your Max Health.

(2 items) Casting an ability that costs Health spawns a blood ball for |cffffff10|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds. 

You or an ally near the blood ball can activate the Sanguine Burst synergy, dealing |cffffff16183|r Disease Damage to nearby enemies and applying Major Maim for |cffffff8|r seconds, decreasing their damage done by |cffffff10|r%. Enemies can only receive Major Maim from Sanguine Burst once every |cffffff20|r seconds. The damage scales off the synergy activator's Max Health.

5.description: (5 items) Adds 1565 Maximum Magicka

6.description: (6 items) Adds 1565 Maximum Stamina

7.description: (7 items) Adds 1722 Maximum Health

8.description: (8 items) Adds 1565 Maximum Magicka

9.description: (9 items) Adds 1565 Maximum Stamina

5.trait: Increases Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff1638|r.

1.description: (1 item) Gain a persistent stack of Escalating Fete every |cffffff2|r seconds you are in combat, up to 30 stacks max. Each stack of Escalating Fete increases your Maximum Stamina, Health, and Magicka by |cffffff88|r. You lose a stack of Escalating Fete every |cffffff4|r seconds you are out of combat.

1.name: Soothing Spores
1.description:
Seed a large area of mushrooms in front of you, healing you and your allies for |cffffff3086|r Health.

Heals for |cffffff15|r% more on allies that are within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

2.name: Ravenous Goliath
2.description:
Become a horrific Ravenous Goliath, increasing your Max Health by |cffffff30000|r for |cffffff20|r seconds and immediately restoring |cffffff30000|r Health. You cannot conceal your presence while active.

While transformed, your damaging Light Attacks restore |cffffff1336|r Health and fully-charged Heavy Attacks restore |cffffff3340|r Health. You deal |cffffff3450|r Magic Damage to nearby enemies every second and heal for that amount. These abilities scale off your Max Health.

While active, taking direct damage reduces the cost of your next Roll Dodge by |cffffff10|r%, up to a maximum of |cffffff100|r%. This effect can stack up to once every half second.

2.name: Dark Cloak
2.description:
Shroud yourself in protective shadow to heal for |cffffff4797|r Health every |cffffff1|r second, over |cffffff3|r seconds, increasing by an additional |cffffff150|r% while Bracing. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

3.name: Path of Darkness
3.description: Create a corridor of shadows for |cffffff12|r seconds, granting you and allies in the area Major Expedition, increasing Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%. Effect persists for |cffffff4|r seconds after leaving the path.

4.name: Aspect of Terror
4.description: Embody a dark spirit to terrify nearby enemies, causing them to cower in fear for |cffffff4|r seconds and be afflicted with Major Cowardice for |cffffff12|r seconds, reducing their Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff430|r.

5.name: Summon Shade
5.description:
Summon a shade version of yourself to attack an enemy and fight at your side for |cffffff22|r seconds. 

The shade slashes at an enemy, dealing |cffffff819|r Magic Damage once every |cffffff2|r seconds, and inflicts Minor Maim for |cffffff4|r seconds, reducing the enemy's damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

6.name: Consuming Darkness
6.description:
Conjure a ring of shadow, reducing the Movement Speed of enemies by |cffffff70|r% and granting you and your allies Major Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Allies in the area can activate the Hidden Refresh synergy, granting them invisibility, increasing their Movement Speed by |cffffff70|r%, and healing them for |cffffff16090|r Health over |cffffff4|r seconds.

1.name: Death Gleaning
1.description: Whenever an enemy you are in combat with dies within |cffffff28|r meters of you, restore |cffffff666|r Magicka and Stamina.

2.name: Disdain Harm

Current duration: |cffffff26|r seconds

7.name: Dark Vigor

8.description:
Increases the duration of your Shadow abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

10.name: Nature's Gift

11.name: Emerald Moss

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Killer's Blade
4.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff1856|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff3343|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

5.name: Echoing Vigor

3.name: Spiked Bone Shield

Surround yourself with a whirlwind of bones, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff20270|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds and returns |cffffff95|r% of direct damage absorbed back to the enemy. This ability scales off your Max Health.

4.name: Healing Seed

5.name: Living Vines

6.name: Ravenous Goliath

This effect can occur once every |cffffff6|r seconds and scales off your Max Health.

(2 items) Casting an ability that costs Health spawns a blood ball for |cffffff10|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff1953|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second.
